name: CategoryCollection
description: Represents the collection of visible chart categories in the document.
remarks: Categories are visible if they have not been filtered out of a chart.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified CategoryCollection object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of categories in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.
